postal_system.postcode_rule: TCRA operates a five-digit numeric system across six mainland zones plus Zanzibar. The first digit is a zone, the first two a region, the first three a district or district CBD, and a full administrative-area code is assigned at ward level. Syntax and prefix hierarchy do not prove that a value is currently assigned, because the allocation plan distinguishes allocated, assigned and reserved values.
postal_system.category_rule: Every full code is typed as administrative_area, post_office, big_mailer, landmark or temporary_event before geometry is interpreted. Post offices and big mailers are delivery objects, landmarks may be areas or points, and temporary events are time-bounded. All five digits do not universally denote a polygon.
postal_system.assignment_rule: A current claim requires a release-pinned TCRA assignment or a permitted dated lookup observation with normalized code, typed category, assigned object, effective time, selected fields and digest. A search row, address example, plan range, reserved value or syntax-valid code is not automatically a current assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: A canonical postcode polygon requires an explicit TCRA geometry for the same typed assignment and validity. A ward/shehia boundary may be used only as a derived review surface when an exact current TCRA administrative-area assignment is joined to the exact rights-cleared NBS or OCGS boundary identity and edition. Coordinates, centroids, post-office points, landmarks, event points, buffers, Voronoi cells, routes, administrative names, OSM features, models and AGID cells are not official postcode polygons.
postal_system.address_rule: Recipient, organization, house number, street, village/mtaa/hamlet, ward or shehia, district, region, physical address code, five-digit postcode and P.O. Box remain separate typed values. TCRA examples place postcode with ward/locality; a P.O. Box uses its post-office delivery context and never proves a residence or building.
postal_system.building_rule: An exact building may be displayed only through a stable explicit rights-cleared LGA or NaPA civic-address-to-building relation. Postcode, ward/shehia containment, address text, parcel, nearest or containing footprint, imagery, OSM feature and model score are candidate context only.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: TCRA allocation covers the United Republic, while every geometry and address artifact must separately declare Mainland Tanzania or Zanzibar scope, custodian, ward or shehia semantics, edition and validity. NBS, OCGS, LGA, land and partner layers are not silently merged or extrapolated.
postal_system.licence_rule: TCRA public lookup and publications do not grant blanket database or address-file redistribution. The 2018 Postal Regulations place address-file dissemination under TCRA. NBS 2022 boundary terms prohibit redistribution or sale without written agreement and restrict use to statistical or scientific research. OSM remains a separate attributed ODbL partition.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Address information is personal data under the Tanzania Personal Data Protection Act. Recipient, resident, contact, household, precise address, physical address code, parcel-person, owner, occupant, delivery and query-log data remain gated. PDPC announced full enforcement from 9 April 2026, including controller and processor compliance duties.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Cloudflare and Hugging Face may host only rights-cleared non-personal immutable artifacts pinned to releases or Hub commits with verified digests. Controlled TCRA address files, NBS-restricted boundaries, precise civic addresses, residents, owners, occupants, deliveries, credentials and sensitive queries stay in approved controlled infrastructure.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index and versioned crosswalk. It does not become a TCRA postcode, postal category, ward/shehia boundary, NaPA address code, LGA house number, cadastral parcel, exact building or delivery entitlement.
